channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 54
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 54 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 54: Pier 54 now uses real Assessor lot lines.
item.description: Pier 54 now uses real Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 9900054.

item.title: Correction · Pier 54: Pier 54 now sits on the real pier. Its outline had been a rough box drawn in open water just south of it. The new outline is traced by hand from satellite imagery, so it is still approximate.
item.description: Pier 54 now sits on the real pier. Its outline had been a rough box drawn in open water just south of it. The new outline is traced by hand from satellite imagery, so it is still approximate. Source: Satellite imagery, Pier & Point's own reading (Esri World Imagery, captured 2025-08-29).
item.source: Satellite imagery, Pier & Point's own reading (Esri World Imagery, captured 2025-08-29)

item.title: Correction · Pier 54: Pier 54 does have its own Assessor lot, number 9900054. This record had said it had none, because the search used to check looked for street names and Port piers do not have one. The outline on the map is unchanged: it is still a hand trace of the pier deck.
item.description: Pier 54 does have its own Assessor lot, number 9900054. This record had said it had none, because the search used to check looked for street names and Port piers do not have one. The outline on the map is unchanged: it is still a hand trace of the pier deck. Source: DataSF, Parcels - Active and Retired (acdm-wktn), the row for Assessor lot 9900054, queried 2026-10-10.
item.source: DataSF, Parcels - Active and Retired (acdm-wktn), the row for Assessor lot 9900054, queried 2026-10-10

item.title: Correction · Pier 54: Pier 54's closure notice was dated December 2024; the Port's own memo shows tenants were formally notified on July 15, 2024, so it is now dated then. The February 2026 draft capital plan entry no longer shows as an upcoming event.
item.description: Pier 54's closure notice was dated December 2024; the Port's own memo shows tenants were formally notified on July 15, 2024, so it is now dated then. The February 2026 draft capital plan entry no longer shows as an upcoming event. Source: https://www.sfport.com/files/2024-08/081324_12a_pier_54_tenant_relocation_rental_assistance_program_final.pdf.

item.title: Added · Pier 54: New nearby-project record for Pier 54, closed and red-tagged in 2024 (SFGate). The Port's draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program (FY2027-31) budgets $2.0M to demolish the pier shed across FY2026-27 and FY2027-28.
item.description: New nearby-project record for Pier 54, closed and red-tagged in 2024 (SFGate). The Port's draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program (FY2027-31) budgets $2.0M to demolish the pier shed across FY2026-27 and FY2027-28. Source: SFGate, 2024-09 (https://discoveryink.wordpress.com/2024/09/08/crumbling-sf-pier-closing-down-forcing-iconic-businesses-to-move/); Port of San Francisco, Draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program FY2027-31, Attachment V, 2026-02 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-02/item_10a.5_attachment_v_fy_2027-31_five-year_cip_draft.pdf).
item.source: SFGate, 2024-09 (https://discoveryink.wordpress.com/2024/09/08/crumbling-sf-pier-closing-down-forcing-iconic-businesses-to-move/); Port of San Francisco, Draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program FY2027-31, Attachment V, 2026-02 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-02/item_10a.5_attachment_v_fy_2027-31_five-year_cip_draft.pdf)

item.title: Milestone · Pier 54: Port's draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program (FY2027-31) budgets a "Pier 54 Shed Demolition" line item totaling $2.0M: $500,000 in FY2026-27 and $1,500,000 in FY2027-28. No line item for full substructure removal appears in the same document, and no source read says the demolition has started. (Feb 2026)
item.description: Port's draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program (FY2027-31) budgets a "Pier 54 Shed Demolition" line item totaling $2.0M: $500,000 in FY2026-27 and $1,500,000 in FY2027-28. No line item for full substructure removal appears in the same document, and no source read says the demolition has started. (Feb 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-02.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 54: Port sends Pier 54's tenants formal written notice of the pier's closure; its August 9, 2024 memo says the 11 tenants will need to vacate by the end of 2024. SFGate reported the closure in September 2024. (Jul 15, 2024)
item.description: Port sends Pier 54's tenants formal written notice of the pier's closure; its August 9, 2024 memo says the 11 tenants will need to vacate by the end of 2024. SFGate reported the closure in September 2024. (Jul 15, 2024). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2024-08-09; SFGate, 2024-09.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 54: Pier 54 is officially red-tagged as unsafe. (~2024)
item.description: Pier 54 is officially red-tagged as unsafe. (~2024). Source: SFGate, 2024-09.
